title: Advertising media
titleCn: 广告媒介类型与优缺点讨论

paragraphs.text: Section three. You will hear a business studies student called Michael talking to his tutor about an assignment on advertising media. First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-one to twenty-six.
Now listen carefully and answer questions twenty-one to twenty-six.
Good morning, Dr. Townsend. I wanted to talk to you about my assignment, the one about using different types of media for advertising. I've got some ideas.

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
thought in the introduction, I'd focus on just one advantage of each type of media. For example, if you choose to advertise in trade publications, you know that you're reaching the right people, the kind you want to attract, because they'll be reading these publications.

00:01:24,580

Right. That's why it's one of the most popular business channels. Okay. Now, did you include email advertising?

00:01:33,040

Yes. That's got various advantages, but I think the main one is you can deliver your message directly without having to go through protocols or agents.

00:01:42,880

Yes. Then, of course, there's the fact that you can reach people anywhere in the world.

00:01:48,300

That's true. But I didn't want to focus on that, as that applies to other media as well nowadays.

00:01:54,480

Fair enough. What about general interest magazines?

00:01:58,900

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
think the advantage of those is that they tend to be less short-lived than other print media. People don't throw them away so readily because production values are high, glossy covers and so on.

00:02:11,800

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
fair point. They're not very good for the environment, but people often pass them on to friends when they're finished with them.

00:02:19,440

Then there are websites. I suppose the advantages of those are fairly obvious, and they give companies an up-to-date image. But I think this is where I'm going to focus on the fact that you can connect with a global audience.

00:02:33,920

There are no barriers.

00:02:36,080

Then I've got cinemas. Although you can't be very selective because cinema goers have pretty diverse interests and needs. The thing is that people are forced to sit through your advert.

00:02:47,400

Exactly. They're unlikely to leave, and they can't switch it off.

00:02:51,920

No. I wanted to mention trade fairs, but I wasn't sure which aspect to focus on. These exhibitions don't usually last very long, do they?

00:03:01,360

That's true. But they are an excellent way of making new contacts and exchanging information, even identifying potential business partners.

00:03:10,600

Oh, right. Thanks. I didn't think of that.

00:03:14,020

Okay, Michael. That all sounds fine. I think that'll make a good introduction.

00:03:19,460

Thanks.

00:03:23,020

Before you hear the rest of the discussion, you have some time to look at questions twenty-seven to thirty.

00:03:33,440

Now listen and answer questions twenty-seven to thirty.

00:03:55,720

Right. Now, let's discuss the main body of your assignment.

00:04:00,160

I've chosen to examine TV advertising.

00:04:03,400

Right. Which aspects are you going to cover and why?

00:04:07,600

I'm going to start with budgeting. I've been reading some useful advice about planning budgets for TV ads. Some of it's pretty obvious, like it's much cheaper if your company produces the ad itself. But a really key tip was to make sure you hold back a certain amount of money to keep the ad running if there's a downturn in business, even if you have to show your ad less frequently or not at the optimum time for your product.

00:04:35,860

Good.

00:04:37,100

And then I'm thinking of giving some information about TV companies.

00:04:41,460

Yes. There's a detailed paper on your reading list on the benefits of going directly to TV companies and getting them to make your ad. But do you think it's relevant to this assignment?

00:04:53,600

Sort of, but I've only gotten information about US TV companies, not about European or Asian companies.

00:05:01,560

And including that would really be straying from the main focus.

00:05:05,640

And I'll need another thousand words.

00:05:08,080

And how do you think companies can check whether their ad will work or not?

00:05:12,810

From experience. But actually, things change. Presumably, what worked last year won't necessarily work this year.

00:05:20,960

Exactly. So what else can they do?

00:05:24,500

Ask staff for keywords to describe the product and use those words in the ad?

00:05:29,760

Or better still, show clients the new ad, take note of their reactions, and make any adjustments before they air it.

00:05:37,680

Yes, because they are the ones that count. Can I ask about attaching a video clip to my assignment?

00:05:44,640

Yes, that's a very good idea. But make sure that the purpose for including it is clear.

00:05:51,280

Yes. I've got one where the actor has a high squeaky voice, and it doesn't go with the product and must put people off.

00:05:59,140

Okay. It's like if you get the music wrong, it detracts from your message. So yes, include it. Well, I think that's everything for today.

00:06:08,820

Thanks.
